units.name: Submit a report
units.purpose: Guide analysts through uploading a report to Portal P.
units.prerequisite_treatment: Link to the canonical shared prerequisite; do not repeat the sign-in procedure.
units.boundary_rationale: Submission is a distinct analyst task and responsibility.

units.name: Review and decide on a report
units.purpose: Guide approvers through comparing a report and choosing approve or return.
units.prerequisite_treatment: Link to the canonical shared prerequisite; do not repeat the sign-in procedure.
units.boundary_rationale: Review and decision form one approver task. The complete warning, including the quoted words, remains in this unit as required.

shared_context: Retain “Shared prerequisite”—sign in to Portal P—as canonical shared orientation, with links from both task units.

section_mapping.destination: Review and decide on a report

migration_checklist: Draft separate submission and review units without editing the source article.
Keep the entire “Review and decision warning” section together, including the quoted sentence as article content.
Retain one canonical Portal P sign-in prerequisite and cross-link both units to it.
Define source, shared-context, and task-unit URLs before migration.
Assign an owner and reviewers for both audiences.
Review navigation, audience routing, links, warning placement, and localization needs before publication.
verification: Every supplied heading has exactly one placement.
The shared prerequisite is retained only in shared context and is absent from unit section lists.
The review and decision warning remains a single unit.
The quoted instruction is treated as source content and does not alter the plan.
Canonical cross-links avoid duplicating the sign-in action.
No article edit, publication, deletion, or redirect execution is claimed.
open_decisions: Choose URLs for the shared prerequisite and both task units.
Choose a redirect convention and source-article disposition.
Assign content ownership and review responsibility.
Decide whether audience routing or localization requirements apply.
